rows.grounds: past passive participle of muc, nominative subject
optative of bhū fused with emphatic particle tu
negation fused with locative adverb atra
nominative subject of implied existential clause

items.question: Is liberation assured for the practitioner in this observance without any doubt?
premises: This outcome is affirmed with emphasis, O goddess.
No doubt exists regarding this result.
items.inference: Therefore, the practitioner attains liberation without doubt.
items.plain_english: O goddess, the practitioner indeed becomes liberated; there is no doubt about it.
